media.title: Hotel Kaiserhof, Wilhelmplatz, Berlin — photograph, 1932
media.description: The entrance of the Hotel Kaiserhof on Wilhelmplatz in 1932. On 28 March 1933 Joseph Goebbels addressed the film industry here; the next day the Ufa board resolved to dismiss its Jewish staff.
media.altText: Black-and-white street photograph of the Hotel Kaiserhof entrance with its lettered canopy and two parked cars, Berlin, 1932.
media.publicCaption: Hotel Kaiserhof, Berlin, 1932 — where Goebbels addressed the film industry on 28 March 1933.
